text:
samir: Heads up — I noticed weird telemetry after the /search canary yesterday. A subset of sessions are tagged `canary=blue` but the traces/metrics show they hit the default backend, so the dashboard error rates look inconsistent.

lucy: Ack. Looks like header-based canary (header `x-canary: blue`) is getting overridden by a path rule for `/search` in some requests. Prob ordering bug in the router policy evaluation.

maya: Which env did this happen in? staging or prod?

samir: Prod, rolling 10%. Minimal router config excerpt I pulled: 
```
- match: path_prefix "/search"
  route: service-search-v1
- match: header "x-canary" == "blue"
  route: service-search-blue
```
Path rule sits above header rule.

alex: That matches our current heuristic: path-first for faster trie lookups. Tradeoff was deterministic path routing for most tenants. But header precedence should be possible for canaries.

lucy: Telemetry makes it worse: metrics with `route_id` are emitted before override rules run. So even when we later route to `service-search-blue`, metrics/logs are stamped `service-search-v1`. Traces need enrichment too.

jen: From rollout UX POV we need per-variant metrics to be trustworthy. Suggest a canary panel (success_rate, p95 latency, error_budget burn) and an automatic rollback alert if delta > configured threshold (eg 2% error rate delta or 20% latency regression).

samir: Proposed fixes: 1) support `canary_precedence: header` as opt-in on routes, 2) emit telemetry after final route resolution, 3) attribute quota/debits to the variant actually served.

alex: Changing global precedence is risky for legacy vhost sharding. Opt-in config sounds safer: `canary: { enabled: true, precedence: header }` on a per-route basis. We'll need simulation tests across sharded vhosts and trie fallback.

lucy: I'll open a PR to move metric emission to post-resolution and update trace enrichment so spans include final `route_id` and `variant`.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: feature-flag `header_canary_precedence` enabled in staging for canary routes — smoke tests running :rocket:

samir: Action items:
- lucy -> telemetry PR & trace fixes
- alex -> design for opt-in config + integration/sim tests
- jen -> add canary dashboard tiles & rollback alert thresholds
- maya -> coordinate staged rollout plan
I'll file tickets and paste links here. :thumbsup:

jen: One more question: quota attribution for embeddings calls — those are expensive. Do we want them counted against variant buckets or a global cost pool?

lucy: Prefer `quota_scope: variant` by default so canary economics are visible, but allow `quota_scope: global` for cost-heavy ops. Add to config proposal.

samir: Sounds good. I'll include `quota_scope` and draft API examples in the ticket. Thanks all, will link PRs/tickets when created.
